recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12707; any future CareTeam.onBehalfOf changes should be evaluated under the later CareTeam semantic issues rather than by restoring this superseded invariant.
issue_request: FHIR-12707 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue raised against DSTU2 to investigate why several FHIRPath expressions for the CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf invariant falsely failed a compliant CareTeam example.
initial_application: The linked Zulip thread records Grahame debugging and fixing the validation problem on 2017-02-09. Git commit f05a2daa11a9003643dc5bc85c77b0dfa88a00fe fixed resolve support while validating resources, and commit 9beeccb2221906b2843a5e7de7b6647fdcdc2ce0 then enabled the CareTeam.participant invariant for FHIR-12647 on 2017-02-10.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml keeps the old ctm-1 invariant only as a commented block and retains ctm-2 as the active participant constraint. Later final issue FHIR-42928 broadened CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf and explicitly removed the Practitioner-only invariant; later applied issues FHIR-48432 and FHIR-51595 added more allowed targets. The combined branch already contains a FHIR-12647 no-change audit documenting the same source family and citing FHIR-12707 as the supporting engine fix.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Reinstating ctm-1 would conflict with later final CareTeam semantics, and the original engine defect was already fixed historically.

related_jiras.note: Requested the CareTeam onBehalfOf element and invariant whose validation failure caused FHIR-12707.
Later Applied issue broadened CareTeam.onBehalfOf and explicitly removed the original Practitioner-only invariant.
Later Applied issue added Group as an allowed CareTeam member/onBehalfOf target.
Later Applied issue added HealthcareService as an allowed CareTeam member/onBehalfOf target.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue reporting that several CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf invariant expressions falsely failed a compliant CareTeam example, with comments that Grahame applied a fix and the issue was fixed.
evidence_items.learned: The seed issue was a FHIRPath engine validation unblocker for the CareTeam invariant rather than a standalone current-source semantic change.

evidence_items.summary: Michelle Miller reported the GF#12647 CareTeam invariant failing validation; Grahame Grieve said resolve() was needed, debugged it, and replied that it was fixed.
evidence_items.learned: This directly confirms the FHIRPath engine investigation and supports treating the seed as historically resolved.

evidence_items.summary: Commit fixed resolve support while validating resources by reading Reference.reference and resolving contained resources in the DSTU3 FHIRPath engine.
evidence_items.learned: The historical engine defect behind the seed issue was fixed before the CareTeam invariant was enabled.

evidence_items.summary: Commit enabled the CareTeam.participant invariant in the CareTeam spreadsheet for FHIR-12647 on 2017-02-10.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-12707 unblocked the intended 2017 source application rather than leaving an unapplied invariant at that time.

evidence_items.summary: CareTeam is active; the current StructureDefinition has ctm-1 only in a commented block, keeps ctm-2 active, and lists the broadened onBehalfOf targets.
evidence_items.learned: The current authoritative build input does not need the old invariant restored and reflects later semantic changes.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue broadened CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf targets, updated the definition, and explicitly required removing the invariant.
evidence_items.learned: This later final decision supersedes the Practitioner-only invariant that FHIR-12707 originally helped validate.

evidence_items.summary: Existing combined-branch FHIR-12647 audit documents the original CareTeam onBehalfOf application, the FHIR-12707 engine support, and later FHIR-42928 supersession.
evidence_items.learned: The same source family has already been reconciled as no-change for the element request, supporting an empty audit for the engine-investigation seed.
